claim_limits: All 2004 F1/F2 source fractions are published rounded decimals, not integer counts; reconstruct feasible integer intervals only, do not fabricate exact raw phenotypes
Class_a F2 676 offspring from 8 crosses share parentage; do not count as 676 independent origins of sex differentiation
The two-locus explanation is a model inferred from segregation, not sequenced contemporary causal sex genes or measured spontaneous mutation paths
F2 and backcross progeny reaching flowering establish biological generation/accessibility, not lifetime viable fitness advantage of all intermediate genotypes

High and low fertilizer use clonally replicated genotypes but individual 23-genotype paired outcome identities are unavailable; derive only combinatorial directional bounds, not exact McNemar statistic or population-adjusted p
Female lack of sex inconstancy observed under these treatments is not permanent loss of all latent genomic competence in all environments
2003 transplant performance, 2004 crossing genetics, 2011 siring arrays and 2012 cost allocation are independent experimental cohorts; do NOT stitch into a same-individual causal fitness mediation
2004 F1 male×monoecious cross shows significant segregation skew, contrary to a perfect Mendelian narrative; F2 pooled tests match predicted genotype ratios
Sagittaria can have monoecy with UNISEXUAL flowers; these are NOT bisexual flowers, unlike protandrous Cyananthus or protogynous Pulsatilla
Sagittaria genetic cross demonstrates possible recombination between existing alleles; does not show new allele origin, establishment from rarity, or fixation through SLK ecological partner feedback
Different carbon/biomass versus nitrogen resource tradeoffs from 2012 are not empirically measured SLK module-building K or single unit
The original 2004 article PDF table was extracted as searchable text and abstract independently verified; web screenshot endpoint failed, so no new hidden exact phenotype counts asserted
